rain_note: Continuous heavy rain in the evening of Monday 15 Aug 2022; no amount reported
summary: Residents' social media posts, quoted by Sierraloaded on 16 Aug 2022, reported Wilkinson Road and other parts of Freetown flooded during continuous heavy rain on the evening of Monday 15 August 2022. The posts include one by Mamadu Sallieu Barrie that Sierraloaded says was on Facebook. This is two days before the 2022-08-17 entry and may belong to the same 14-17 Aug spell that Caritas describes.
evidence: "Wilkinson Road is flooded as it's raining heavily in the capital of Sierra Leone, Freetown," Sahr Kafineh posted. (post quoted in Sierraloaded's 'BREAKING: Flooding in Freetown'; text as rendered in the search snippet)
